description: Transmission Oil Temperature - Voltage Above Normal, or Shorted to High Source
likely_causes: Short to a high source, open sensor or return, connector/harness damage or sensor fault. Test circuit per OEM procedure.
source_citation: SAE J1939-71 MAR2011, Appendix B, SPN 177; SAE J1939-73 SEP2006, Appendix A, FMI 3

description: Transmission Oil Temperature - Voltage Below Normal, or Shorted to Low Source
likely_causes: Short to a low source or ground, reference loss, damaged wiring or sensor fault. Test circuit per OEM procedure.
source_citation: SAE J1939-71 MAR2011, Appendix B, SPN 177; SAE J1939-73 SEP2006, Appendix A, FMI 4

description: Transmission Oil Temperature - Data Valid but Above Normal Operating Range - Least Severe Level
likely_causes: Developing transmission cooling/load problem or biased sensor reading. Compare temperature trend with load, slip and cooler operation.
source_citation: SAE J1939-71 MAR2011, Appendix B, SPN 177; SAE J1939-73 SEP2006, Appendix A, FMI 15

description: Transmission Oil Temperature - Data Valid but Above Normal Operating Range - Moderately Severe Level
likely_causes: Overload/slip, low fluid, restricted cooler or flow, operating-load condition or biased sensor reading. Verify fluid and cooling system.
source_citation: SAE J1939-71 MAR2011, Appendix B, SPN 177; SAE J1939-73 SEP2006, Appendix A, FMI 16

description: Engine Fuel Rate - Data Valid but Above Normal Operational Range - Most Severe Level
likely_causes: Abnormally high fuel delivery, injector/metering fault, incorrect derived inputs or biased fuel-rate data. Compare with load and actual consumption.
source_citation: SAE J1939-71 MAR2011, Appendix B, SPN 183; SAE J1939-73 SEP2006, Appendix A, FMI 0

description: Engine Fuel Rate - Data Valid but Below Normal Operational Range - Most Severe Level
likely_causes: Restricted/inadequate fuel delivery, injector/metering fault, incorrect derived inputs or biased fuel-rate data. Compare with load and actual consumption.
source_citation: SAE J1939-71 MAR2011, Appendix B, SPN 183; SAE J1939-73 SEP2006, Appendix A, FMI 1

description: Engine Fuel Rate - Data Erratic, Intermittent or Incorrect
likely_causes: Unstable fuel delivery, invalid calculated inputs, sensor/network fault or implausible fuel-rate data. Diagnose source measurements and supply condition.
source_citation: SAE J1939-71 MAR2011, Appendix B, SPN 183; SAE J1939-73 SEP2006, Appendix A, FMI 2

description: Engine Rated Speed - Data Erratic, Intermittent or Incorrect
likely_causes: Incorrect/incompatible calibration or configuration data. Verify engine rating and ECU configuration rather than treating this as a speed-sensor circuit fault.
source_citation: SAE J1939-71 MAR2011, Appendix B, SPN 189; SAE J1939-73 SEP2006, Appendix A, FMI 2

description: Engine Rated Speed - Bad Intelligent Device Or Component
likely_causes: Internal configuration-memory/controller fault. Verify correct software/calibration and stable power/grounds; follow OEM module diagnostics.
source_citation: SAE J1939-71 MAR2011, Appendix B, SPN 189; SAE J1939-73 SEP2006, Appendix A, FMI 12

description: Engine Rated Speed - Out Of Calibration
likely_causes: Missing/incorrect engine configuration or calibration mismatch. Verify rated-speed data and programming using OEM service information.
source_citation: SAE J1939-71 MAR2011, Appendix B, SPN 189; SAE J1939-73 SEP2006, Appendix A, FMI 13

description: Engine Speed - Data Valid but Above Normal Operational Range - Most Severe Level
likely_causes: Engine overspeed, incorrect governor/control response, driveline driving engine or invalid speed data. Verify actual speed and operating conditions.
source_citation: SAE J1939-71 MAR2011, Appendix B, SPN 190; SAE J1939-73 SEP2006, Appendix A, FMI 0

description: Engine Speed - Data Erratic, Intermittent or Incorrect
likely_causes: Crank/cam signal mismatch, intermittent speed sensor, damaged tone wheel, air-gap or wiring fault. Compare speed sources and waveform.
source_citation: SAE J1939-71 MAR2011, Appendix B, SPN 190; SAE J1939-73 SEP2006, Appendix A, FMI 2

description: Engine Speed - Abnormal Frequency or Pulse Width or Period
likely_causes: Speed sensor, tone wheel, mounting/air gap, severe misfire/speed fluctuation or intermittent wiring. Inspect mechanical signal and waveform.
source_citation: SAE J1939-71 MAR2011, Appendix B, SPN 190; SAE J1939-73 SEP2006, Appendix A, FMI 8

description: Engine Speed - Abnormal Rate of Change
likely_causes: Intermittent speed signal, extreme acceleration/deceleration, misfire or tone-wheel/wiring fault. Compare waveform and other speed sources.
source_citation: SAE J1939-71 MAR2011, Appendix B, SPN 190; SAE J1939-73 SEP2006, Appendix A, FMI 10

description: Engine Speed - Condition Exists
likely_causes: Application-specific engine-speed condition with no more specific FMI. Use related DTCs, starting symptoms and OEM service information.
source_citation: SAE J1939-71 MAR2011, Appendix B, SPN 190; SAE J1939-73 SEP2006, Appendix A, FMI 31

description: Transmission Output Shaft Speed - Data Erratic, Intermittent or Incorrect
likely_causes: Intermittent output speed sensor, damaged target, air-gap or wiring fault, or implausible gear-ratio data. Compare input, output and vehicle speed.
source_citation: SAE J1939-71 MAR2011, Appendix B, SPN 191; SAE J1939-73 SEP2006, Appendix A, FMI 2

description: Transmission Output Shaft Speed - Abnormal Frequency or Pulse Width or Period
likely_causes: Output speed sensor, target wheel, mounting/air gap or intermittent wiring fault. Inspect waveform and mechanical signal generation.
source_citation: SAE J1939-71 MAR2011, Appendix B, SPN 191; SAE J1939-73 SEP2006, Appendix A, FMI 8

description: Transmission Output Shaft Speed - Abnormal Rate of Change
likely_causes: Intermittent output speed signal, driveline shock/slip, damaged target or wiring fault. Compare calculated ratios and related speed PIDs.
source_citation: SAE J1939-71 MAR2011, Appendix B, SPN 191; SAE J1939-73 SEP2006, Appendix A, FMI 10

description: Engine Total Hours of Operation - Data Erratic, Intermittent or Incorrect
likely_causes: Corrupt hour-meter data, ECU replacement/configuration mismatch or incorrect network source. Verify against asset maintenance records; do not alter records to match automatically.
source_citation: SAE J1939-71 MAR2011, Appendix B, SPN 247; SAE J1939-73 SEP2006, Appendix A, FMI 2

description: Engine Total Hours of Operation - Bad Intelligent Device Or Component
likely_causes: Internal controller or nonvolatile-memory fault affecting stored hours. Follow OEM module diagnostics and preserve documented machine hours.
source_citation: SAE J1939-71 MAR2011, Appendix B, SPN 247; SAE J1939-73 SEP2006, Appendix A, FMI 12

description: Engine Total Hours of Operation - Received Network Data In Error
likely_causes: Invalid hour data from the source ECU or network/configuration problem. Diagnose the data source and reconcile with documented equipment hours.
source_citation: SAE J1939-71 MAR2011, Appendix B, SPN 247; SAE J1939-73 SEP2006, Appendix A, FMI 19

description: Actual Engine - Percent Torque - Data Erratic, Intermittent or Incorrect
likely_causes: Invalid torque calculation inputs, speed/fueling anomalies or network data problem. Compare actual, driver-demand and friction torque parameters.
source_citation: SAE J1939-71 MAR2011, Appendix B, SPN 513; SAE J1939-73 SEP2006, Appendix A, FMI 2

description: Actual Engine - Percent Torque - Abnormal Rate of Change
likely_causes: Rapidly changing fueling/load, intermittent torque calculation inputs or network/source-data problem. Request and compare stable live data.
source_citation: SAE J1939-71 MAR2011, Appendix B, SPN 513; SAE J1939-73 SEP2006, Appendix A, FMI 10

description: Actual Engine - Percent Torque - Received Network Data In Error
likely_causes: Invalid torque data from the supplying ECU or network/configuration problem. Diagnose the source ECU and its torque inputs first.
source_citation: SAE J1939-71 MAR2011, Appendix B, SPN 513; SAE J1939-73 SEP2006, Appendix A, FMI 19

description: Nominal Friction - Percent Torque - Data Erratic, Intermittent or Incorrect
likely_causes: Invalid calculated friction inputs, changing accessory load or incorrect configuration/source data. Compare actual and reference torque parameters.
source_citation: SAE J1939-71 MAR2011, Appendix B, SPN 514; SAE J1939-73 SEP2006, Appendix A, FMI 2

description: Nominal Friction - Percent Torque - Abnormal Rate of Change
likely_causes: Rapidly changing calculated parasitic/accessory load or invalid source data. Compare torque inputs and operating conditions before component diagnosis.
source_citation: SAE J1939-71 MAR2011, Appendix B, SPN 514; SAE J1939-73 SEP2006, Appendix A, FMI 10

description: Nominal Friction - Percent Torque - Received Network Data In Error
likely_causes: Invalid calculated data from the supplying ECU or network/configuration problem. Diagnose the source ECU and its torque inputs first.
source_citation: SAE J1939-71 MAR2011, Appendix B, SPN 514; SAE J1939-73 SEP2006, Appendix A, FMI 19

description: Engine's Desired Operating Speed - Data Erratic, Intermittent or Incorrect
likely_causes: Invalid throttle/governor/cruise request inputs or incompatible control messages. Compare desired speed with actual speed and control-mode data.
source_citation: SAE J1939-71 MAR2011, Appendix B, SPN 515; SAE J1939-73 SEP2006, Appendix A, FMI 2

description: Engine's Desired Operating Speed - Abnormal Update Rate
likely_causes: Missing/late speed-control messages, requesting controller offline, network fault or configuration mismatch. Diagnose the requesting module and network.
source_citation: SAE J1939-71 MAR2011, Appendix B, SPN 515; SAE J1939-73 SEP2006, Appendix A, FMI 9

description: Engine's Desired Operating Speed - Received Network Data In Error
likely_causes: Invalid desired-speed data from another controller or network/configuration problem. Diagnose the requesting module and message source.
source_citation: SAE J1939-71 MAR2011, Appendix B, SPN 515; SAE J1939-73 SEP2006, Appendix A, FMI 19

description: Engine Requested Torque/Torque Limit - Data Erratic, Intermittent or Incorrect
likely_causes: Invalid torque request, conflicting controllers, configuration mismatch or intermittent request messages. Compare request source and control mode.
source_citation: SAE J1939-71 MAR2011, Appendix B, SPN 518; SAE J1939-73 SEP2006, Appendix A, FMI 2

description: Engine Requested Torque/Torque Limit - Abnormal Update Rate
likely_causes: Missing/late torque-control messages, requesting controller offline, network fault or configuration mismatch. Diagnose request source and network.
source_citation: SAE J1939-71 MAR2011, Appendix B, SPN 518; SAE J1939-73 SEP2006, Appendix A, FMI 9

description: Engine Requested Torque/Torque Limit - Received Network Data In Error
likely_causes: Invalid torque request from another controller or network/configuration problem. Diagnose the requesting module and message source.
source_citation: SAE J1939-71 MAR2011, Appendix B, SPN 518; SAE J1939-73 SEP2006, Appendix A, FMI 19

description: J1939 Network #1, Primary Vehicle Network - Data Erratic, Intermittent or Incorrect
likely_causes: Intermittent CAN wiring/connectors, termination or grounding problem, failing node, message/configuration conflict. Capture bus errors before replacing modules.
source_citation: SAE J1939-73 SEP2006, §5.7.13.4 (SPN 639), Appendix A, FMI 2

description: J1939 Network #1, Primary Vehicle Network - Abnormal Frequency or Pulse Width or Period
likely_causes: CAN timing/physical-layer fault, incorrect baud-rate configuration, wiring/termination problem or incompatible node. Verify network configuration and waveform.
source_citation: SAE J1939-73 SEP2006, §5.7.13.4 (SPN 639), Appendix A, FMI 8

description: J1939 Network #1, Primary Vehicle Network - Abnormal Update Rate
likely_causes: Missing/late J1939 messages, source ECU offline, CAN open/short/termination fault or configuration mismatch. Identify the missing message/source first.
source_citation: SAE J1939-73 SEP2006, §5.7.13.4 (SPN 639), Appendix A, FMI 9

description: J1939 Network #1, Primary Vehicle Network - Special Instructions
likely_causes: The reporting controller requires a manufacturer-specific network diagnostic. Identify controller and OEM instructions; do not assume a generic CAN repair.
source_citation: SAE J1939-73 SEP2006, §5.7.13.4 (SPN 639), Appendix A, FMI 14

description: J1939 Network #1, Primary Vehicle Network - Received Network Data In Error
likely_causes: Received error-substitute data, invalid source data, node/configuration fault or intermittent CAN communication. Diagnose the source ECU and related sensor.
source_citation: SAE J1939-73 SEP2006, §5.7.13.4 (SPN 639), Appendix A, FMI 19

description: J1939 Network #1, Primary Vehicle Network - Condition Exists
likely_causes: Application-specific network condition. Capture the reporting ECU, related DTCs and CAN activity, then follow its OEM network diagnostic procedure.
source_citation: SAE J1939-73 SEP2006, §5.7.13.4 (SPN 639), Appendix A, FMI 31

description: J1939 Network #2 - Data Erratic, Intermittent or Incorrect
likely_causes: Intermittent CAN wiring/connectors, termination or grounding problem, failing node, message/configuration conflict. Capture bus errors before replacing modules.
source_citation: SAE J1939-73 SEP2006, §5.7.13.5 (SPN 640), Appendix A, FMI 2

description: J1939 Network #2 - Abnormal Frequency or Pulse Width or Period
likely_causes: CAN timing/physical-layer fault, incorrect baud-rate configuration, wiring/termination problem or incompatible node. Verify network configuration and waveform.
source_citation: SAE J1939-73 SEP2006, §5.7.13.5 (SPN 640), Appendix A, FMI 8

description: J1939 Network #2 - Abnormal Update Rate
likely_causes: Missing/late J1939 messages, source ECU offline, CAN open/short/termination fault or configuration mismatch. Identify the missing message/source first.
source_citation: SAE J1939-73 SEP2006, §5.7.13.5 (SPN 640), Appendix A, FMI 9

description: J1939 Network #2 - Special Instructions
likely_causes: The reporting controller requires a manufacturer-specific network diagnostic. Identify controller and OEM instructions; do not assume a generic CAN repair.
source_citation: SAE J1939-73 SEP2006, §5.7.13.5 (SPN 640), Appendix A, FMI 14

description: J1939 Network #2 - Received Network Data In Error
likely_causes: Received error-substitute data, invalid source data, node/configuration fault or intermittent CAN communication. Diagnose the source ECU and related sensor.
source_citation: SAE J1939-73 SEP2006, §5.7.13.5 (SPN 640), Appendix A, FMI 19

description: J1939 Network #2 - Condition Exists
likely_causes: Application-specific network condition. Capture the reporting ECU, related DTCs and CAN activity, then follow its OEM network diagnostic procedure.
source_citation: SAE J1939-73 SEP2006, §5.7.13.5 (SPN 640), Appendix A, FMI 31
